Question Q-9877: How many days are there from 2022-10-13 to 2023-01-22 (count the end date but not the start date)?

Answer: 101 days.

Calculation: Oct 14-31 = 18 days; Nov = 30 days; Dec = 31 days; Jan 1-22 = 22 days. Total = 18 + 30 + 31 + 22 = 101.
